shiftLock.slot: Red nylon release handle under the CUPHOLDER in the center console. Lift and pull the cupholder insert UP to expose the handle. Pull to engage Neutral.
steps: PREFERRED (with power): Turn ignition to ON. Shift to N using the traditional floor shifter.
WITHOUT POWER — red handle method:
Pull the cupholder insert UPWARD firmly — it pops off its clips.
Locate the red nylon handle in the console cavity.
Press the brake pedal firmly.
Pull the red handle toward you (or push, depending on early vs late build) to release Park.
Confirm vehicle can roll before loading onto flatbed.
Vehicle must be on FLATBED — permanent 4WD, cannot disable AWD.
Apply parking brake.
Battery is under the hood — connect jump pack.
Attempt to restore 12V power first to confirm N selector position.
Use red cupholder handle method if power unavailable.
FLATBED ONLY — permanent full-time 4WD.
TRANSFER CASE: must be shifted to 2WD/2H before towing. IF BATTERY IS DEAD: jump battery FIRST, shift TC to 2WD, then disconnect. If TC cannot be shifted: FLATBED ONLY.

tow.method: FLATBED PREFERRED. Flatbed with TC in neutral. Four-wheel-down: TC in neutral, max 30 mph / 30 miles. NEVER wheel-lift front or rear only — permanent AWD will destroy drivetrain.
notes: PERMANENT AWD: never wheel-lift front or rear only — drivetrain destruction guaranteed.
TC must be in Neutral for flatbed loading. Electronic dial requires 12V power.
Air suspension: may have risen/lowered — vehicle height may be non-standard when found.

battery.jumpPoints: Under hood — standard red (+) / black (−) terminals
battery.warning: TC must be in Neutral for flatbed. Permanent AWD — no wheel-lift.

alerts.warning: Transfer case MUST be in Neutral (flatbed) or 2H equivalent. Permanent AWD — cannot wheel-lift without TC neutral.
alerts.notes: Permanent AWD — transfer case neutral required for flatbed. 4-wheel tow: strict 30 mph / 30 mile limit.

issues.title: Permanent AWD — Wheel-Lift Will Destroy Drivetrain
issues.detail: The L322 Range Rover has permanent 4WD. You CANNOT use a standard wheel-lift without putting the transfer case in Neutral first. Attempting to tow with only two wheels on the ground while TC is engaged will destroy the transfer case, transmission, and differentials.

issues.title: Air Suspension Failure Common on High-Mileage Units
issues.detail: EAS air suspension failure is extremely common on L322 Range Rovers. Vehicle may be sitting very low (at bump stops) when found. This affects loading angle and clearance. Note: the front air springs and rear air springs fail independently.

shiftLock.slot: Emergency Park Release (EPR): red nylon handle under CUPHOLDER insert in center console. Remove cupholder inserts. Locate the EPR handle. Turn locking mechanism to UNLOCK. Pull handle up. NOTE: The rotary drive selector will show P but gear display flashes N — this is correct.
steps: PREFERRED (with power): Turn ignition to ON. Rotary selector rises — rotate to N.
WITHOUT POWER — EPR procedure:
Remove the cupholder inserts from the center console.
Locate the EPR handle (red/orange nylon strap).
Turn the locking mechanism (small lever or twist) to the UNLOCK position.
Press the brake pedal firmly.
Pull the EPR handle UPWARD until it latches in the vertical position.
The rotary selector will remain showing P but the display flashes N — the vehicle IS in Neutral.
CRITICAL: The recovery agent MUST activate the EPR before towing. Do not use rotary P for recovery.
FLATBED ONLY — permanent electronic 4WD.
Apply parking brake and chock wheels.
CRITICAL per Land Rover owner manual: Recovery agent must activate EPR before towing begins.
Attempting to load without EPR activation can seriously damage the transmission.
Activate EPR using cupholder method above.
Confirm display shows flashing N before loading.
FLATBED ONLY.
TRANSFER CASE: must be shifted to 2WD/2H before towing. IF BATTERY IS DEAD: jump battery FIRST, shift TC to 2WD, then disconnect. If TC cannot be shifted: FLATBED ONLY.

tow.method: FLATBED STRONGLY PREFERRED with TC in Neutral. Four-wheel-down tow: TC in Neutral, max 30 mph / 30 miles ONLY. NEVER wheel-lift front or rear only.
notes: Permanent AWD — no front or rear wheel-lift alone without TC in neutral.
TC electronic — requires 12V power to shift. Jump first if dead.
L405 is very heavy — verify flatbed weight capacity.
30 mph / 30 mile limit strictly enforced for four-wheel tow.

battery.warning: AGM rated jump pack required. TC must be in Neutral for flatbed. Permanent AWD.

alerts.warning: PERMANENT AWD — no wheel-lift without TC neutral. Flatbed strongly preferred.
alerts.notes: Rotary dial shifter. Red handle under cupholders is the manual override. TC must be in Neutral for flatbed.

issues.title: EPR MUST Be Activated Before Towing — Owner Manual Warning
issues.detail: Land Rover's owner manual explicitly states: 'The recovery agent MUST activate the Emergency Park Release before towing commences. The procedure is covered in a separate publication for service personnel.' Failure to activate EPR can result in serious transmission damage. The rotary selector will show P even after EPR is activated — the flashing N on the gear display confirms EPR is active.

WITHOUT POWER:

Press brake pedal firmly.
Pull the red nylon handle to release Park lock.

Apply parking brake.

Connect jump pack.
Use red handle method or shift normally once powered.
TC must be in Neutral for flatbed.

tow.method: FLATBED with TC in Neutral. Four-wheel-down: TC neutral, max 30 mph / 30 miles.

tow.method: FLATBED PREFERRED with TC Neutral. Four-wheel-down: TC Neutral, max 30 mph / 30 miles.

shiftLock.slot: Electronic rotary dial shifter. Override slot near base of rotary dial — small trim cap. ZF 9HP transmission: requires 12V power to shift reliably. Restore battery first.
steps: ZF 9HP: RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST — this transmission is very difficult to shift without power.
Connect jump pack to battery under the hood.
Turn ignition to ON — rotary selector rises.
Rotate dial to N normally.
Without power — override slot at base of rotary dial: insert thin flathead, press firmly, rotate dial to N.
Significant force may be required without power — ZF 9HP resists mechanical override.
Apply parking brake.
Main battery under hood OR auxiliary battery under passenger glove box foot well.

Restore power. Use rotary dial to select N.

issues.title: Auxiliary Battery Under Glove Box
issues.detail: The Evoque has a small auxiliary battery under the passenger-side glove box foot area. This battery powers the rotary selector safety system. If the main battery is dead but this aux battery has charge, you may be able to use it to shift into Neutral without a full jump.

ACCESSORY MODE TIP: Press start button WITHOUT foot on brake — this gives accessory power. Then press brake and shift to N.
WITHOUT POWER — EPR:

Turn EPR locking mechanism to UNLOCK.
Press brake firmly.
Pull red EPR handle upward to vertical — latches in place.
Display flashes N to confirm.
Apply parking brake.

issues.title: Shift Lock Solenoid Failures
issues.detail: Some LR4 model years have documented shift lock solenoid failures that prevent the shift interlock from releasing even with the override method. If the red handle method fails and the vehicle has power, a failing solenoid may be the cause. Flatbed with TC in neutral is the safest fallback.

MANUAL: depress clutch fully and move gear lever to Neutral.
Apply parking brake.

Once powered, shift normally.

issues.detail: The Range Rover Classic has permanent 4WD with no 2WD mode. You CANNOT wheel-lift from either end without first putting the transfer case in Neutral. Attempting to tow with only two wheels off the ground while TC is engaged will destroy the transfer case and differentials.

shiftLock.slot: Console-mounted selector — override slot near selector base
steps: Turn ignition to ON (key to Run position — do not start).
Locate the shift lock override: cap or slot near selector base on center console.
Pry off the plastic cap with your ignition key or a small flathead screwdriver.
Insert the key (or a thin flathead) into the slot and press firmly downward.
While holding the slot, press the brake pedal.
Move the selector from Park to Neutral.
Remove key from slot and replace cap.
Apply parking brake.
Battery under the hood — connect jump pack.
Once powered, press brake and shift normally.
FLATBED ONLY — Freelander Haldex AWD cannot be disabled. No 2WD mode.
MANUAL: depress clutch and move to Neutral. FLATBED ONLY — no 2WD.

issues.title: No Physical Gear Lever — Touch Panel Requires 12V Power
issues.detail: The Range Rover Velar uses a fully electronic touch-panel gear selector. There is no physical lever to move. Without 12V power, the panel is dead and cannot select any gear. The EPR (red handle under cupholder) is the only mechanical option when power is lost. Always jump the battery first if at all possible — this is far easier than the EPR procedure.

issues.title: Touch Panel Has No Mechanical Override — Power Required
issues.detail: The Range Rover Velar (L560) uses a fully electronic touch-capacitive gear selector panel. Unlike rotary selectors (which have a red EPR handle), the Velar touch panel has NO mechanical cable or lever backup. Without 12V power the gear cannot be changed at all. Always restore battery power before attempting to shift. If power cannot be restored, the rear wheels must be lifted to load onto a flatbed.
